utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Vik, I've already got a pile of old clocks and a blender from Mrs. Chen—she says the blender still works, but it sounds like a helicopter taking off!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's awesome, Tess! I'll make sure to tell everyone you're bringing a helicopter-blender to the repair drive this Saturday—they'll love it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Vik, you're going to make me the talk of the neighborhood with that helicopter-blender story! I just hope the repair folks can actually fix it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll be there at 8 sharp to set up. Will you join us, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'll be there, but I do hope others have signed up in advance—I'd hate to see a chaotic rush with no schedule in place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Don't worry, Pia—I've already got a list of tasks and times ready, and Quinn's bringing donuts to keep things orderly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mina, the screws are for the playground bench, not the drive. I've got both things sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you're handling the playground bench and the repair drive? That sounds like a lot — how do you keep track of everything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a list. Easy enough.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Jules, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm thinking of signing up for my porch step—do you know if there's still room?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, there's still room! Sam's got it set for Saturday morning at his garage—I'm pulling in my book club crew, so the more the merrier. Want me to put you down?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That'd be wonderful, Jules! Please put me down for the porch step. I heard about it from Mrs. Chen—so glad there's still space.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's tomorrow, but I'm not entirely sure either. Maybe we should check the community board together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The community board! Right, that big cork thing by the mailboxes. I walked past it yesterday... or was that last month?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Let's go check it now, I don't mind walking over there with you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the shed at the community garden—want me to count you in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Quinn! I was just talking to Rosa about it—I’ve got a couple of wrenches and some spare parts I can bring. Need me to round up any donations from the neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect, Cleo! If you could ask around for any old lumber or paint, that'd really help us get the shed looking sharp.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got Eli showing up at 8, but the official start is 10 at the community center. Let me double-check my timeline so we're all aligned.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, 10 o'clock at the community center. I'll make sure to be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Dane. Gus has the tools ready—hammers, screwdrivers, and his power drill. I'll see you there for setup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, I think there's some confusion. I did ask about a repair drive, but it was for the community center's computers, not the garden shed. Let me double-check the board notes to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, computers! Sorry, I've been mixing up all sorts of things lately. Is Jules still organizing that?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I believe Jules is the one handling it. Let me confirm the time and details before we go further.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring some tools for the metalwork if that helps—just let me know what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Uli! Metalwork tools would be a huge help. Do you have a good angle grinder or maybe some welding gear? I think a few fence gates need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got a reliable angle grinder and some welding rods. How many gates need attention?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, next Saturday you say? I must've mixed up the dates. Might swing by if I get the chance.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's next Saturday at 9. Leo's got the tools ready, so should be a smooth morning if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, good—Leo's got it covered. I'll try to stop by if I can break free from chores.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, Rosa, got my tools ready and a good feeling about this repair drive—we'll sort out any hiccups together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's wonderful, Gus! Just a heads up, the drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center now—hope that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem at all, Rosa—Sunday works for me. I'll just adjust my schedule and bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, Faye, good timing! We’re just getting the teams set up. I can put you on the tool sorting crew if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds great, Mara. Tool sorting works for me — just let me know the times so I can work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, we're starting right now actually, so you can jump in — we'll be done well before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Cleo, the repair drive is set for Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Can you help with the tool inventory?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, I'll grab my spare wrench set and meet you there—let me know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Cleo. I'll have the full tool list ready by Friday so we can double-check everything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll pick up the screws on my way back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Leo. See you at the school gate Saturday morning then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I'll bring my own screwdriver and a thermos—see you at 8.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a plan, Eli! I'll bring some extra coffee and pastries from Rosa's bakery to keep everyone fueled.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, that'll be a nice addition. I'll still be there at 8 to get things set up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll grab a few extra screws from my shed, just in case we run short.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, screws! I meant to bring my toolbox, but now I'm wondering if I left it at the park last week. Did you see it there?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I didn't notice it when I was by the playground yesterday, but I can take a look after we finish here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So what exactly are we collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We're collecting gently used clothes, small appliances, and tools to repair and redistribute. The drive is now Sunday at the community center, starting at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday at 9 AM at the community center — got it. Do we need to sort things when we get there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You're on the list, Nell! I'll bring my tool kit over Saturday morning and get that step sorted for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's wonderful, Gus! Thank you so much—I'll make sure to have some lemonade ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Lemonade sounds perfect! See you Saturday morning, neighbor.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll be there this Saturday — happy to help with any repairs or just keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great to hear, Rey! We could use an organized hand to direct folks where they're needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I'll bring a clipboard and some labels so people can find their stations easily.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late! What did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane! We're all set for the repair drive this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center—I'm on fence repairs, Sam's handling heavy lifting, and Tess is bringing the tools. Want in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds great, Vik! I'll grab my gear tonight—count me in for whatever team still needs an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Dane, can you help me double-check the tool inventory? I want to make sure we have enough wrenches for the plumbing team.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Mara, I just got word from Vik—the repair drive's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Want me to rally a few more folks from the block?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Quinn! The more hands, the better. I'll make sure we have extra tasks ready, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Nell just told me she hadn't heard about the sign-up sheet—I better make it very clear tomorrow morning that people need to check in first to keep things moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sign-up sheet? I think I left mine in the fridge... or was that the toaster? I'll just show up and hope for the best!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oren, please don't just show up! The sign-up sheet helps us avoid a bottleneck—let me add you now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good morning! I heard there's a repair drive this weekend. Is that the one for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that's the one! I've been rounding up old electronics all week—even Vik's bringing in a few things. You got anything gathering dust?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Old electronics? I thought it was for fixing the garden shed and benches—are we talking about the same repair drive?
